column3: Extends the water image to flourishing, adornment, and abrupt loss, testing durable value against surface maturity.
Directly frames truth and falsehood as a mixed, concealing layer; it sharpens the foam-versus-residue contrast.
A weak fire-route resonance adds only a threshold scene, without the flood or separating process.
Adds the status of parables and divergent reception, without specifying the two material processes.
The same water amid adjacent, differentiated land supplies a close counterpart to measured valleys and varied yield.

Traces descending water through the earth, varied growth, withering, and fragmentation; it broadens the focus's process image.

Rain restoring land adds a compact sign of beneficial transformation after apparent lifelessness.

Water from above as provision reinforces the focus's human-benefit criterion.
Rain stirring and growing the earth gives a compact renewal parallel to productive permanence.
Rain after despair and its spread develop water as effective, timely benefit.
Water reviving land is directly joined to signs for understanding, supporting the focus's parabolic function.
Blessed water yielding gardens and grain supplies a durable-output counterpart.
Opened sky and pouring water preserve a flood-process parallel, though without the focus's evaluative ending.
Ground springs joining the flood add a complementary routing and convergence image.

Poured water followed by food-bearing growth gives a compact, direct productive-process counterpart.
Bringing forth pasture begins a growth-and-aftermath sequence relevant to the focus's material transformation.
